Dear Commanders
An update patch will be available for Steam of Iron Saga VS which will include the following KoL improvement:

Sorry for any inconvenience this may have caused. Thanks for your support for Iron Saga VS!
Iron Saga VS Operations Team

notes.title: Update Patch (March 21, 2025)
notes.notes:
To provide you with a better gaming experience, an update has been released on March 21st UTC+8. Please update the game in your Steam Library and start the game. This update includes the following bug fixes:

Patch Note 1.0.2.1 (March 21, 2025)
Patch Time: 2025-03-21 19:30 UTC+8
BUG FIXES: 
· Fixed the temporary disappearance of both characters after a clash;
· Fixed the screen flickering during a battle.

Patch Note 1.0.1.1 (March 21, 2025)
Patch Time: 2025-03-21 18:20 UTC+8
BUG FIXES: 
· Fixed the crash on Boss Borot when it performed the Power Max Supermove - Brave Rocket under Boss's Treasure Arsenal during the battle.
· Fixed some visual problems during the battle.

Please restart the game and update from your Steam Library to apply the update. Thanks for your support!

notes.title: V0.7.5.1 Update Announcement
notes.notes:
Dear Players,

The server will undergo a version update soon. You can obtain the latest version by logging back into the game.

The following bugs have been fixed in this update:

▪ Fixed an issue where some players encountered errors after completing online battles.
▪ Fixed an issue where errors occurred when viewing replays.
▪ Fixed an issue where display anomalies in the game caused errors.

Thank you for your continued support!

notes.title: Patch Notes - October 18th
notes.notes:
Version: 0.6.5.1
Update Time: October 18th, 2024 (UTC+8)

The development team has released a version update today, addressing several known issues. The details are as follows:

1. Fixed visual effect scaling and character teleport errors in certain language environments.
2. Resolved game freezing or errors caused by high-frequency actions when starting or ending online battles.
3. Fixed desynchronization errors that occurred at the start of the second round in online battles.

The update will take effect after the Steam update. Thank you for your support!
